cases.description: Operation contract whose input/output declarations and `requires` dependency are stated EXPLICITLY in the source: calculate_brokerage(premium, rate) -> brokerage; record_brokerage(brokerage) requires calculate_brokerage. That makes the ground truth exact, including a genuinely proven producer->consumer data-flow binding. The operations have no implementation behind them, so they must be reported as unresolved / not executable — proven data flow is not the same as executable.
